name: plane
description: Manage Plane workspaces, projects, cycles, modules, and work items through the Plane MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Plane work items, projects, cycles, modules, and workspace data.
interface.longDescription: Use Plane from Codex through the Plane MCP server. This plugin is preconfigured for the enterprise Plane instance at https://plane.ledupeiyou.com and workspace slug ledu. Authorize it by providing only PLANE_ACCESS_TOKEN. Project-scoped MCP work requires a concrete project id resolved from an explicit id, a verified Plane link, the repo-local plane-project.json binding, or a user choice from list_projects.
defaultPrompt: Find my Plane work items for a project id and summarize blockers.
Create Plane work items for this implementation plan in the selected or repo-bound project.
Review Plane project status for the current cycle.
